Connect with a metals partner that understands your business.
More than 125,000 customers come to Reliance for an unmatched combination of metals variety, precision processing, and industry expertise.
Our strength – and our position as North America’s largest metals service center company – comes from our people. Their focus, expertise, and commitment turn metal into momentum.
We provide a comprehensive range of metal products and processing solutions that deliver precise, efficient, and dependable results across diverse industries.

Reliance sells and processes metal, delivering to customers just-in-time. Each company is an expert in its region and industry, adapting quickly to changing market conditions to offer custom solutions and exceptional service. Backed by a vast network of metals service centers, our Family of Companies can easily scale to accommodate any project and the most exacting customer requirements.

Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co. operates as a metals service center company primarily in the United States and Canada. The company provides metals processing services and distributes a line of approximately 100,000 metal products, including alloy, aluminum, brass, copper, carbon steel, stainless steel, titanium, and specialty steel products to mills and original equipment manufacturers.

Additionally, the company will commemorate the completion of the integration of its $1.2 billion acquisition of Metals USA, along with the closing of two smaller acquisitions earlier this month, Northern Illinois Steel Supply Co. and Aluminum Services UK Ltd.
